query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animals WHERE ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%') as remaining_buyer_animals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animalOwnerships WHERE animalId NOT IN (SELECT id FROM animals)) as orphaned_ownerships,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animalMedia WHERE animalId NOT IN (SELECT id FROM animals)) as orphaned_media;
